scope: durable provider-neutral AI chat turn state, live product-route persistence, replay, reconnectable streaming, execution ownership fencing, response acceptance, resource admission, and crash recovery

authority.rule: turn runtime coordinates durable state only and does not own provider transport or privileged tool execution

invariants: streamed client output is never authoritative completion state
all durable transitions are monotonic and digest chained
terminal states cannot transition
turn replay must reject sequence gaps, cross-operation events, and broken digest chains
resource budget overflow fails closed
child budgets cannot exceed remaining parent authority
consequential tool effects without a durable receipt are ambiguous
ambiguous consequential tool effects require receipt reconciliation before retry or continuation
model execution may be retried after restart because it cannot directly own privileged external side effects
provider receipts, tool receipts, and conversation commits remain external authoritative records
runtime stores structured reason codes and provenance rather than hidden chain-of-thought
turn persistence stores operation state only and never duplicates canonical transcript authority
portable and production persistence decode the canonical runtime wire schema
Mongo event persistence uses prepare, atomic snapshot advance, and committed-marker recovery
public stream projection excludes arbitrary model, prompt, retrieval, and tool payload content
stream reconnect is bound to operation identity, exact sequence, and prior event digest
live product chat persists durable turn state around canonical conversation and engine milestones
product replay heals existing durable turn completion without synthesizing historical turn journals
public reconnect transport requires operation, sequence, and digest continuity
same-operation retries preserve the original durable conversation binding while revalidating request digest and causal user identity
transient engine or provider unavailability leaves the durable turn resumable instead of fabricating terminal completion
cancellation request acknowledgement is non-terminal until the engine confirms a terminal cancelled state
at most one live execution holder owns mutable model or terminal progression for a turn
every execution ownership takeover increments a monotonic fencing epoch
heartbeat renewal invalidates the previous lease token even when the fencing epoch is unchanged
lease-bound durable event append validates holder epoch digest and expiry at the atomic write boundary
Mongo crash recovery discards a prepared event when its authorizing lease is stale expired or superseded
ownership acquire renew release and takeover mutations produce a digest-chained audit receipt
live engine output cannot enter canonical transcript state without a response-acceptance receipt bound to exact operation execution context and output
live response-acceptance receipts hash output and evidence references instead of storing response prose or provider receipt contents
engine-backed live chat requires an accepted verification identity and at least one canonical provider receipt before transcript commit
synchronous and deferred engine results must pass the same canonical response-acceptance policy before transcript commit
live response acceptance binds both engine operation identity and execution identity before transcript promotion
complete provider receipt sets are bound into durable chat events by a content-minimized aggregate reference
tool restart handling cannot convert consequential ambiguity into reexecution before canonical reconciliation evidence
governed attachment bindings contain content-addressed and artifact references but never raw attachment payload bytes
structured claim evidence is bound to exact operation and context identity before the live acceptance gate can require it
chat verification profiles consume canonical verification receipts and never create a second verification authority
promotion_rule: implemented candidate only; no completion or verification signoff until exact-head CI and independent verification pass
next_integrations: bind canonical VerificationReceipt sets from the engine terminal result into the Volume-9 chat verification acceptance profile before response promotion
make the canonical engine emit structured VerificationClaim objects plus Volume-8 ClaimEvidenceReceipt records and enable require_structured_claim_evidence on the product route
cut remaining product attachment upload paths over to governed artifact storage and sandbox extraction receipts before context admission
connect external-system reconciliation probes to resolve_tool_restart so in-doubt effects can be proven committed or no-effect
qualify the expanded AI-chat evidence surface with exact-head CI and independent digest verification

persistence.commit_protocol: prepare immutable event -> exact-sequence/digest operation snapshot advance -> committed marker
persistence.conversation_binding: tenant, owner, thread, causal user message, admitted thread version
persistence.transcript_rule: turn repositories never own or duplicate conversation message content

streaming.content_rule: project structured transition metadata only; arbitrary durable event payload is not exposed
streaming.gap_rule: sequence or digest-chain mismatch fails closed
streaming.transport_rule: projection is transport-neutral and can feed SSE, WebSocket, polling, or native clients

live_route.turn_binding: canonical thread plus causal user message plus admitted thread version
live_route.replay_rule: historical assistant replay does not synthesize a new journal; existing durable journals are reconciled forward
live_route.retry_binding_rule: an existing durable operation wins over later thread-version drift after operation, request, tenant, owner, thread, and causal-user identity are revalidated
live_route.transient_failure_rule: configuration, availability, protocol, memory-backend, and provider transient failures do not fabricate a terminal durable turn
live_route.cancellation_rule: cancellation_requested is an acknowledgement state; only engine terminal cancelled closes the durable turn

ownership.fence: strictly monotonic per-operation epoch plus exact lease digest
ownership.holder_rule: one live holder per operation; competing acquisition fails closed
ownership.heartbeat_rule: renewal preserves epoch but increments heartbeat sequence and replaces the accepted lease digest
ownership.takeover_rule: only expired or released ownership can be replaced; takeover increments epoch
ownership.write_rule: lease-bound append checks holder, epoch, lease digest, and expiry inside the persistence CAS
ownership.crash_rule: prepared Mongo events carry their authorizing lease and are discarded before replay if that lease is no longer current
ownership.audit_rule: acquire, renew, release, and takeover emit digest-chained ownership receipts

response_acceptance.execution_rule: observed engine operation and execution identities must exactly match the canonical chat operation and execution identities
response_acceptance.verification_rule: verification must be canonical and explicitly accepted by the live policy
response_acceptance.provider_rule: engine-backed live chat requires at least one canonical provider receipt and rejects malformed or duplicate receipt identity
response_acceptance.output_rule: non-empty UTF-8 output is digest-bound and hard-bounded before canonical commit
response_acceptance.minimization_rule: acceptance receipts store hashes of output and receipt references rather than response prose or provider receipt contents
response_acceptance.rejection_rule: rejected engine output is terminalized and never committed as a canonical assistant message
response_acceptance.transcript_binding: accepted assistant messages carry response-acceptance-sha256:<digest> in canonical artifact references

application_first_install.authority: Existing canonical conversation thread/message Mongo rows and chat-turn journal; canonical engine owns execution/provider/tools/memory/governance. No new store, service, scheduler or provider boundary.

prepared_execution.storage: Private bounded operational metadata on the same canonical USER message write-ahead row; exact EngineExecutionCommand and request digest are persisted before thread sequence commit.
prepared_execution.replay: First committed message command wins; exact request digest, message/actor/tenant/operation/execution/context identities and command SHA revalidated on every read/resume. No reconstruction of changed prompt/options/context/deadline.
prepared_execution.expiry: Never reissue expired delegated command; canonical terminal failure marker frees conversation ordering without fabricated model output.
prepared_execution.cancellation: Private same-row dispatch CAS: ready -> submitting before engine intake; only ready can be atomically withdrawn without claiming engine cancellation. Submitting/admitted cancellation remains intent until actual canonical terminal truth; exact frozen retry never forks or reissues a withdrawn command.
prepared_execution.generic_edit: Generic conversation edit rejects an original USER with prepared AI execution metadata or marker before publication. Copy into a new message instead; editing requires a separately frozen canonical command and fresh request identity, and is not exposed as supported by this integration.

stream.source: Existing immutable digest-chained chat-turn events; no synthetic engine-event cursors or fabricated token deltas. Canonical final text only after verified assistant commit.
stream.terminal: chat.final without SSE id, exact canonical turn response
stream.reconnect: Last-Event-ID or explicit after_sequence+last_event_digest; validate cursor against canonical journal even for empty replay pages. Disconnect detaches only.
stream.body_replay: Existing bounded body middleware replays each buffered request chunk once, then delegates to the original ASGI receive for real disconnect/cancellation. It never fabricates recurring empty http.request frames. Initial size/in-flight byte admission unchanged.

context.memory: Explicit bounded memory IDs only from canonical governed memory authority, exact owner/tenant/current active/version/content identity; never new memory bank or caller text promoted to memory.
context.crawler: Explicit bounded current owned crawler records through dragon_crawler adapter; fetched text remains untrusted evidence, review/rights/current source checks remain owner authoritative. No direct feature fetch or automatic training.
context.dispatch: Revalidate current referenced records before admission/replay/final commit; no stale withdrawn evidence reuse.
context.history: Selected canonical history user/assistant messages inherit exact original operational source dependencies through causal user IDs. Bound full original metadata before materialization: max256 causal users/8MiB; validate each complete command+record digest against canonical causal USER before extracting refs. Flatten/deduplicate pins within total8memory/4crawler bounds or fail before message/model dispatch. Fresh users carry a constant prepared-execution marker so missing private command is corruption, not absent source obligations. Legacy unmarked pre-wave rows retain explicit compatibility. Withdrawal fences transitively prevent future inference through retained assistant text.
context.citation_metadata: Crawler evidence is one bounded untrusted canonical JSON envelope containing exact current canonical source URL, title, authority/review labels, passage text and its independently validated passage SHA. Segment content SHA binds the entire model-visible envelope; provenance retains exact captured-source and passage SHA. URLs are supplied evidence, not verified model citations; generated citation quality is not asserted.

application_first_install.tools: Only existing typed delegated application owners; read/research context remains data. No model-supplied unconstrained tool executor or capability expansion.
application_first_install.validation: Static source checks and authorized actual API/model workloads only; user no-tests instruction persists.

conversation_bounds.admission: Mongo aggregates bounded public-record BSON bytes/count before returning transcript payloads; private command metadata excluded from public reads. Missing parents/cycles/active branch fail closed, never silent first500 history.
conversation_bounds.metadata: Title1..200 under existing owned active/archived exact-version CAS and canonical governed storage admission.

application_first_install.bson_timestamps: Canonical conversation and chat-turn adapters request timezone-aware UTC BSON decoding on their own collection handles only. Newly issued Mongo lease grant/expiry timestamps are normalized to BSON milliseconds before hashing/persistence. Existing journal/receipt hashes are never rewritten; old incompatible leases expire before a new fenced epoch. Shared legacy database defaults and pure contracts remain unchanged.
application_first_install.readiness: Public /ai/status, /providers and model discovery read canonical provider inventory under a 2-second bound. configured and availability_observed are distinct; engine URL presence never means a ready model. No generation/health probe or secret transport data during discovery.
application_first_install.export: Authenticated exact owned active/archived thread and expected-version fence; server renders canonical active lineage only after every thread/message lifecycle record is active, exportable and within retention. Bound8MiB UTF8; SHA of exact returned content. Excludes private prepared commands, internal instructions, raw source/attachment payloads and other tenant inventory.

current_main_reconciliation.authority: Existing canonical conversation USER row, prepared engine command and current-tip/version CAS; no second command owner/store.
current_main_reconciliation.edited_user_rebind: Main Save and resend remains supported. A canonical edit removes superseded execution metadata; a fresh exact request/prepared command/source snapshot/dispatch binding is written once together on that same current USER row under current tip/version CAS. Inherited old bindings cannot be replayed as the edited request.
current_main_reconciliation.historical_records: Read adapters recognize immutable main command/request-reference metadata and the continuation envelope without rewriting original bytes/digests. Ambiguous or unprovable legacy authority is observe-only/fail-closed.
current_main_reconciliation.public_exports: Retain main governed conversation export schema and the explicitly labelled continuation export projection with the same owner/version/retention/size/digest authority.
current_main_reconciliation.existing_attachment_and_dragon_dependenc: Preserve main bounded attachment refs and explicitly consented configured Dragon projection. Existing prepared context envelope may pin at most four exact canonical attachment segments and three configured Dragon query/source checkpoints. Existing resolvers recheck identity/permission/retention before dispatch, resume and final publication and when selected through inherited conversation history. Existing memory/crawler-only receipts remain readable; no new source, model or state authority.
current_main_reconciliation.current_input_lineage: Prospective current input is explicitly identified by the preparing canonical route, validated as the expected USER/thread/next sequence or current edited tip and matched to the exact compiled segment ID/content digest. Only that current input is excluded from prior-history traversal; unknown historical IDs remain fail-closed. Current direct source dependencies retain their own authority checks.
